newsitem.title: USA: North American sees strong sales.
newsitem.headline: North American sees strong sales.

text.p: North American Resorts Inc said Monday sales volume for the second quarter of 1996 was about $845,000, with pre-tax profits of about $110,000. Sales volume for the first half of 1996 was about $1,749,000, which the company said surpasses its total sales volume for all of 1995.

The company said additionally that it is "looking forward to a very strong second half." It said it expects sales volume for 1996 will be more than double its 1995 sales volume, "with an increase in earnings."
Tom Arrigoni, a senior consultant for North American, said the company reported total sales of 1.6 million in 1995 and a net loss for the year of $948,171.
Separately, the company said it is forming an 80-percent owned subsidiary, North American Resorts Travel Inc, that will be a fully licensed travel services company.
North American markets vacation club memberships and operates Cypress Island in Orlando, which it plans to develop into a private membership resort.
